top_signals.title: Dubai’s DIP to Hold Meetings for UAE’s First Listing Since War
top_signals.summary: Dubai Investments Park Development Co. is pushing ahead with plans for what could be the United Arab Emirates’ first initial public offering this year despite the regional war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
